podcast.title: Early Hip Hop DJ
podcast.body: Africa Bambaataa is mentioned as one of the first great, complex, professional DJs to emerge from the tornabilismo culture, defining the way to use turntables. "desde los DJs que definen la manera de usar los platos como africa bambata."

podcast.title: Genuine Musical Genius
podcast.body: Africa Bambaataa is recognized as one of the "genuine stars, genuine musical geniuses" of the early rap and hip-hop scene, whose contributions were not always taken seriously by the wider music market. "It didn't matter that there were genuine stars, genuine musical geniuses. One DMC, Curtis Blow, Africa Babata, Grandmaster Flash, LL Cool J, the scene and the sounds were just not taken seriously."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pioneer of Hip Hop Culture
podcast.body: Africa Bambaataa is highlighted as a significant cultural promoter and the great precursor of hip hop culture, playing a key role in its emergence in the New York suburbs in the late 1970s. He was instrumental in establishing hip hop as a broad cultural movement, not solely musical, with activities often centered in local civic centers. "posiblemente africa bambata fue el gran precursión de la cultura hip hop"

srcs.episode: Diferencia entre RAP y HIP-HOP. Por qué ya no son lo mismo.
